review.why: Records decisions in ADRs and detects docs that drifted from code, using git history rather than confidence.
review.summary: Covers architecture decision records (match the repository's existing convention first, then a template and lifecycle), why-not-what comments, API docs, README structure, changelogs and docs for agents. A prose review must keep qualifiers and numbers, and a git-based drift check says 'can't tell' when history is unordered.
strengths: Matches the project's existing ADR convention before using its own template
Drift check from commit order that never reports 'current' when unsure
Prose review that must preserve qualifiers, numbers and trade-offs
cautions: Instructions only: one shell snippet, no scripts or files
Treats rules files such as CLAUDE.md as documentation to keep current
